The issuer exhibits strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 27% on 8.67B in quarterly revenue, backed by a massive asset base of 192.3B. However, its capital structure is highly leveraged (total liabilities of 139.7B against 51.5B in equity) and its short-term liquidity is constrained, as evidenced by a current ratio of 0.63 (current assets of 12.2B versus current liabilities of 19.4B). These solid business fundamentals balanced against significant leverage and tight near-term liquidity align with a solid investment-grade rating in the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB
